name: Race Tech Race Cars and Components, Inc.
old_description: Race Tech Race Cars and Components is a leading manufacturer of fine racing machines.
about:
Race Tech Race Cars and Components, Inc. operates from Burlington, North Carolina, where it has built custom race cars since 1988. The company was founded by Russ Farmer, a champion driver and builder who remains president and CEO. What began as a specialist in dragster construction has grown into a full-service race-car manufacturer serving competitors across multiple classes.

The shop produces complete dragsters, roadsters, and doorslammers, each designed in CAD and fabricated in-house. Capabilities include aluminum and sheet-metal fabrication, MIG/TIG welding, tube bending, and CNC plasma cutting on a 4-by-8-foot table that handles aluminum, steel, and stainless up to 1/4-inch thick. Race Tech also assembles AN braided-stainless hoses as an authorized Goodridge distributor and provides in-house powder coating, polishing, chroming, custom painting, and graphics. A parts division stocks accessories and hardware, including Grade 8 fasteners used throughout its builds.

Customers range from NHRA world champions and big-money bracket racers to local enthusiasts. Recent winners in Race Tech cars include Brian Weber at Famoso Raceway, TG Paschal at Piedmont, and Anthony Bertozzi at the NHRA Sportsman Nationals. The company also serves local racers with nitrous bottle refills and one-off fabrication projects such as fuel cells, carts, and structural components.

Farmer started the business to deliver race cars that combine reliability with ease of maintenance. Design features such as optimized driveline angles, 4-link brackets tuned for instant-center location, a removable crossmember for transmission access, and a master cylinder mounted outside the driver compartment reflect that focus. The in-house finishing suite eliminates outsourcing delays, giving teams a single source from chassis to paint.
